title: docs(adr-0142): mark the D3 amendment on the status line; annotate plan item 1 as superseded
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEyP5fgvDswGwJU9prPHL9U)_

Part of #27016

## What changes

The two should-fixes from the delta contract review on #27044 (comment `6461102189`), both in ADR-0142:

- The `**Status**:` line gains `· **Amended** (2026-10-28, ruling 6457475657 on #25769, letter A)`, saying that D3's `current_user.queues` producer is `@objectstack/plugin-security`, kernel-side, under the reserved key `queues`. This is the amended-status-line convention the README states, in the form ADR-0028/0050/0055 use. `docs/adr/README.md`'s ADR-0142 row is regenerated (`node scripts/adr-index.mjs`).
- Execution plan item 1's clause "the queue service and its `queues` membership-resolver key in `plugin-sharing`" is kept as history and annotated: *superseded 2026-10-28 by D3 as amended: plugin-security resolves `queues` kernel-side*.

The stale `Proposed` status is left alone: the review places that flip with #26337, the PR that landed the implementation.

## Why

#27044 amended D3 to ruling A but left the record carrying option B's mechanism in the plan, undated, and no marker on the status line. Seat 1 chose to land #27044 from the queue and take these as a follow-up.

## Verification

- `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check`: exit 0.
- Diff against `main`: 2 files, +3/−3, docs only. Nothing publishes, so no changeset (`skip-changeset`).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` is CI's repo-wide run.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Publishes nothing.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
